defect.problem: The pin-2179 lake quote is corrupt: it contains page markdown/frontmatter and background/rule prose rather than the cited opinion passage. The actual displayed quote on the content page is a short sentence, but the lake pinpoint payload does not faithfully record it. The lake also marks this pinpoint quote_fidelity as mismatch and has no page/star marker.
defect.proposed_fix: Replace the pin-2179 quote with the actual opinion sentence, "A witness does not expressly invoke the privilege by standing mute.", and do not assert 133 S. Ct. at 2179 unless disclosed star pagination supports that page.

reasons: The asserted pinpoint quote begins with content-page markdown, not opinion text.
The disclosed text contains the relevant legal sentence as: "A witness does not expressly invoke the privilege by standing mute."
The lake pinpoint itself flags quote_fidelity as mismatch and provides no star marker or page value.
residual_risks: The legal proposition on the page appears supported, but the lake pinpoint record cannot support the quote/pin as framed.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Keep the rule, but repair the pin record and separately verify the S. Ct. page.

reasons: The quoted phrase appears in the Alito plurality opinion when line-wrapped hyphenation is normalized: "Fifth Amendment claim fails because he did not expressly invoke the privilege against self-incrimination".
The content page uses the quote as a partial quotation within an accurate paraphrase of the plurality holding.
residual_risks: The cached text line-breaks self-incrimination as self- / incrimination, so exact automated character matching may fail unless hyphenated line wrapping is normalized.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Store the full source sentence or mark the quote as normalized from line-wrapped slip text.

reasons: Treatment/currency is outside lens A, so no treatment defect is raised.
The content page treatment fields match the disclosed lake record: good_law, as_of_content 2013-06-17, as_of_treatment 2026-06-30, varies_by_point false, and the same fractured-decision scope note.
residual_risks: No lens A review of treatment currency was performed.
